steps.text: Optional but much better: 2 minutes a side on a dry griddle until it marks.
Cottage cheese (100/135 g) into a bowl, chunks over.
Pumpkin seeds (8/11 g) and chia (6/8 g) scattered over.

why: Salt on pineapple. It does the same job it does on melon — pulls the sweetness back so the fruit reads as sharp, and the cottage cheese stops tasting bland beside it.
notes: No ruled defects or D0-003 substitutions apply (no oil, no lettuce). The griddle step is explicitly optional in the original text; timed here at its stated 2-minutes-a-side when done. Skipping it drops the whole card to a genuinely untimed 3-minute assembly, matching the card's own chip.
